items.title: Melba Liston — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] [knows Marl, but cannot recall the singer’s name.]

ctx.x: What’s the girl who was with Lucky Millinder, married Marl Young? Didn’t she sing – I saw her there. Not Joya Sherill.
[knows Marl, but cannot recall the singer’s name.]
